selinux.name: SELinux
selinux.description: Kernel-enforced mandatory access control via LSM policy domains. Confines processes to least-privilege security contexts regardless of DAC permissions.

apparmor.name: AppArmor
apparmor.description: Path-based mandatory access control using per-application profiles.

seccomp.name: Seccomp
seccomp.description: Kernel syscall filtering that restricts the system calls a process can invoke, reducing kernel attack surface.

container-runtime.name: Container Runtime Security
container-runtime.description: Container runtime controls including namespace isolation, rootless execution, and sandbox runtimes that strengthen container boundaries.

pod-security.name: Pod Security
pod-security.description: Kubernetes-level controls that enforce security policies on pod specifications, restricting container capabilities and privileges.

systemd-sandboxing.name: systemd Service Sandboxing
systemd-sandboxing.description: Process-level isolation using systemd service directives that restrict filesystem access, device access, and privilege escalation paths.

authentication-methods.name: Authentication Methods
authentication-methods.description: Controls that enforce strong authentication mechanisms including multi-factor, key-based, and protocol-level authentication.

password-policy.name: Password Policy
password-policy.description: Controls that enforce password quality, rotation, and lockout policies to strengthen credential resilience.

session-management.name: Session Management
session-management.description: Controls that manage credential lifecycle including session timeouts, token rotation, and idle session termination.

authorization-controls.name: Authorization Controls
authorization-controls.description: Application-layer controls that enforce role-based access, object-level permissions, and least-privilege authorization policies.

origin-cors.name: Origin and CORS Controls
origin-cors.description: Browser-enforced controls that restrict cross-origin requests, cookie scope, and CSRF attack vectors.

injection-prevention.name: Injection Prevention
injection-prevention.description: Controls that prevent injection attacks across SQL, command, LDAP, template, and other interpreter-based injection vectors.

input-validation.name: Input Validation
input-validation.description: Controls that validate, sanitize, and constrain application inputs to prevent traversal, SSRF, file upload abuse, and other input-driven vulnerabilities.

transport-crypto.name: Transport Cryptography
transport-crypto.description: Controls that protect data in transit through TLS configuration, SSH hardening, and encrypted tunnel enforcement.

mount-options.name: Mount Option Hardening
mount-options.description: Filesystem mount options that restrict execution, setuid, and device access on mounted filesystems.
